name: Rumah KIDS
summary: Gives abused, orphaned and abandoned children a safe, loving home and supports them through school until they can live independently.
programmes: Residential children's homes in Klang and Subang Jaya (USJ)
Daily care: food, clothing, education and health
Volunteer and CSR activities with the children
impact: 36 children aged 3-18 currently in care across 4 homes (website, 2026)
More than 300 children raised in its homes since 1991 (website, 2026)
beneficiaries: Abused, orphaned and abandoned children aged 3 to 18

organisation.founders: Dr. Henry Pillai, founding chairman until he retired in 2020
organisation.leadership: Mr. Panir Rajamany (Chairman); Ms. Jessica Tang (Vice Chairman); Ms. Luna Koh (Secretary); Ms. Claire (Treasurer); Mr. David Jansen Nathan (Senior Manager, Public Relations)
